title: Polish Bacon Crispy Skillet
description: A simple, savory dish made with crispy bacon, perfect for a quick dinner or lunch.

ingredients.name: Polish bacon
ingredients.notes: Look for Polish bacon at your local deli or use thick-cut American bacon as a substitute

instructions: Cook the Polish bacon in a skillet over medium heat until crispy, flipping halfway through.
Remove the bacon from the skillet and place it on a paper towel-lined plate.
Crack the eggs into the same skillet and scramble them. Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and cook for 5 minutes.
Remove the skillet from the oven and top the eggs with the crispy Polish bacon.
Serve hot and garnish with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
